title: Magic Boxes
goal: A variable is a box with a name. Put something in, get it back later.
mascot_lines: Imagine a little box with a name on the outside.
We can put one thing inside, like the word 'Sam'.
Later, when we say the box's name, the computer remembers what's inside.
Programmers call these boxes 'variables', and they're how computers remember stuff.

payload.prompt: Drag each thing into its labeled box.

tier2.rephrase: Each box has a name. Match the picture to the name that fits.

tier3.nudge: A cat goes with PET. Sam is a name. 7 is a number. Pizza is food. Drag each one home!
